title: Kissed Dense Brazilian Coconut Pudding
description: A sour and dense Brazilian dessert featuring golden syrup, made dairy-free friendly and cooked on a comal.
instructions: In a mortar, pound the unsweetened shredded coconut until it is well broken down and fragrant.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the coconut milk, golden syrup, brown sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, and salt.
Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Stir in the pounded coconut and water.
Pour the pudding into a heatproof vessel and cook on a preheated comal over low heat for 5 minutes, or until the bottom is lightly caramelized.
Remove the pudding from the comal and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover the pudding and refrigerate it for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
